correctness.rationale: Truncated-octahedral graph is 24 signed permutations of (0,1,2), edges squared distance 2, with 36 edges and exactly 48 signed-coordinate graph automorphisms. Unordered two-particle Abrams chain ranks (276,792,558), and an independent mod-two d2 rank503 plus 55 pairwise disjoint facet-boundary torus cycles establish rational H2=55, H1=14; 55 tori are independent mod2 by the source verifier and their integral basis follows from Barnett-Farber planar ORDERED facial-torus theorem plus equivariant transfer for two-sheeted unordered quotient and the free H2 integer kernel. Reconstructed 6 square and 8 hex facets, all 55 disjoint pairs, 48 signed permutations, orbit lengths (3,4,12,12,24) and H2 signed fixed-pair character multiset. Four same-type orbits contain orientation-swapping stabilizers and contribute no invariant; mixed 24 orbit yields primitive invariant integral sum. Source 10-class S4xC2 character and quotient invariant dimensions (0,1),(2,1),(7,24) follow from signed cellular Lefschetz and exact inner products; no integral H1-lattice claim.
